note: No pyramidion of Khufu, Khafre or Menkaure survives, so this is the size of the best preserved royal pyramidion, Amenemhat III's from Dahshur (Cairo JE 35133), 1.40 m high on a base of 1.85 m, whose slope of about 57 degrees is close to the pyramids' own. The limestone one reassembled at the Red Pyramid and the one found in 1993 beside Khufu's satellite pyramid G1-d are of the same order. It is used only for how high on the apex the joint under the capstone is drawn in the as-built render; the capstone takes the pyramid's own slope, so its base follows from this and the angle. Sigma 0.6 m spans the surviving examples.
